template.title: Patience on the Porch
template.summary: A child learns that sitting still can help a scared animal become a friend.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] sat on the front porch, looking at the small [[slot_animal]] that peeked from behind a bush.
The [[slot_animal]] shivered and kept its distance, its [[slot_noise]] soft and shy.
[[slot_child]] tried to call the animal, shouting, "Come here!" but the animal ran away.
[[slot_child]] felt a little sad, then remembered a trick taught by a grown-up.
[[slot_child]] decided to sit still, just like a statue, and held out a piece of [[slot_treat]].
The animal watched [[slot_child]] with curious eyes, sniffing the air.
[[slot_child]] held breath, watching the [[slot_animal]] take one tiny step forward, then another.
The animal finally crept closer and sniffed [[slot_child]]'s hand, wagging its tail.
From that day, the [[slot_animal]] visited often, and [[slot_child]] learned that patience can make new friends.
